released_routes_flashing_icon.details: AlertTriangle icon used for Released Routes in sidebar. CSS animations (cautionFlash, colorFlash) present in App.css. Flashing only activates when releasedRoutesCount > 0.

route_release_auto_move.details: Route release API removes route from contractor (sets assigned_contractor_id to null) and creates released_route record in database. Admin notification created automatically.
